_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Point of No Return#002.src: You... could it be...? Are you... real?
Point of No Return#002.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#003.src: Ha... ha... you should not have come here.
Point of No Return#003.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#004.src: Have you seen the others? Barely clinging on to life... hollowed, empty.
Point of No Return#004.dst: 你看到其他人了嗎？勉強吊著一口氣……被掏空了，什麼都不剩。
Point of No Return#004.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#005.src: Only I persist. And, now... you, too, have been ensnared.
Point of No Return#005.dst: 只有我撐了下來。而現在……你也被纏上了。
Point of No Return#005.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#006.src: Fight against your fate, if you so choose... it makes no difference in the end. Ha... ha... ha...
Point of No Return#006.dst: 想抵抗你的命運就抵抗吧……到頭來沒有任何差別。哈……哈……哈……
Point of No Return#006.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#017.src: Do not worry, you are safe here. The Obelisk protects us all.
Point of No Return#017.dst: 別擔心，你在這裡很安全。方尖碑保護著我們所有人。
Point of No Return#017.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#018.src: An beacon of safety amidst the terror outside... what a miracle, to have found it awaiting us in our time of need.
Point of No Return#018.dst: 外面盡是恐懼，這裡卻是一座安全的燈塔……在我們最需要的時候它就在那裡等著，多麼奇蹟。
Point of No Return#018.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#019.src: Rest well, friend. You have made it home. Feel free to familiarize yourself with it.
Point of No Return#019.dst: 好好休息吧，朋友。你到家了。隨意熟悉一下這個地方。
Point of No Return#019.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#020.src: How long has it been since a new face has joined us? I can't quite seem to recall...
Point of No Return#020.dst: 上一次有新面孔加入我們是多久以前了？我實在想不太起來……
Point of No Return#020.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#021.src: Don't be fooled everything you see around you is very real.
Point of No Return#021.dst: 別被騙了——你在周圍看到的一切都非常真實。
Point of No Return#021.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#022.src: ...more than anything beyond, at least. The Obelisk protects us, after all.
Point of No Return#022.dst: ……至少比外面的任何東西都真實。畢竟，方尖碑保護著我們。
Point of No Return#022.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#023.src: Do you feel its pull? It calls to us all, when we arrive.
Point of No Return#023.dst: 你感覺到它的牽引了嗎？我們每一個抵達的人，它都會呼喚。
Point of No Return#023.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#024.src: Why would anyone choose to resist? The world is twisted, wrong... we do not belong there.
Point of No Return#024.dst: 有誰會想抵抗呢？那個世界扭曲、錯亂……我們不屬於那裡。
Point of No Return#024.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#025.src: It is by the Bovine's grace that the Obelisk has seen fit to bless us with this sanctuary.
Point of No Return#025.dst: 是牛神的恩典，讓方尖碑願意賜給我們這座避難所。
Point of No Return#025.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#026.src: There is no fault in giving in. It only wants to protect us. Is that so wrong?
Point of No Return#026.dst: 屈服並沒有錯。它只是想保護我們。這樣有什麼不對嗎？
Point of No Return#026.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#027.src: Why would you ever want to leave?
Point of No Return#027.dst: 你到底為什麼會想離開？
Point of No Return#027.speaker: Lutho Guard

Point of No Return#031.src: If you truly want to leave... no one here will stop you. But are you really willing to go through with it?
Point of No Return#031.dst: 如果你真的想走……這裡沒有人會攔你。但你真的願意付出那個代價嗎？
Point of No Return#031.speaker: Lutho Guard

Point of No Return#032.src: Talk to the {p} Citizen who sent you on this journey.
Point of No Return#032.dst: 回去找那位把你送上這趟旅程的 {p} 市民。

Point of No Return#033.src: Ha... I saw it there. That flicker in your eyes...
Point of No Return#033.dst: 哈……我在那裡看見了。你眼裡那一絲閃動……
Point of No Return#033.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#034.src: You have been... shattered. Just like me, ha, ha, ha...
Point of No Return#034.dst: 你已經……碎了。跟我一樣，哈，哈，哈……
Point of No Return#034.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#035.src: The others... all have given into its pull. Our band of survivors... left behind, abandoned...
Point of No Return#035.dst: 其他人……全都屈服於它的牽引了。我們這群倖存者……被留下、被拋棄……
Point of No Return#035.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#036.src: I cannot blame them. Such a loss must seem a blessing, compared to life out here...
Point of No Return#036.dst: 我不能怪他們。比起在外頭活著，那樣的失去恐怕像是恩賜……
Point of No Return#036.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#037.src: How long has it been, since we found ourselves trapped here...? Longer than anyone has any right to live... ha, ha...
Point of No Return#037.dst: 我們被困在這裡多久了……？久得超過任何人有權活著的長度……哈，哈……
Point of No Return#037.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#038.src: Perhaps I am already gone. More dead than alive. Hollowed out...
Point of No Return#038.dst: 也許我早就不在了。與其說活著，不如說已經死了。被掏空……
Point of No Return#038.speaker: Lutho Citizen

Point of No Return#039.src: All it does is take. More, and more, and more, until nothing is left... ha, ha, ha...
Point of No Return#039.dst: 它只會索取。更多，更多，再更多，直到什麼都不剩……哈，哈，哈……
Point of No Return#039.speaker: Lutho Citizen
